ideas.title: The $9 Billion Minnesota Fraud: An Investigative Report
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the alleged $9 billion stolen from Minnesota state services and programs.
ideas.angle: Follow the money, data analysis, and public records to uncover the scope and perpetrators of this massive alleged fraud scheme.
questions: Who are the individuals and entities involved?
How did the alleged fraud occur?
What can be done to prevent similar schemes in the future?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the alleged $9 billion stolen from Minnesota state services and programs, following the money and analyzing data to uncover the scope and perpetrators of the scheme.

ideas.title: The Impact of Medicare Enrollment Freeze on Healthcare Providers
ideas.description: An examination of the impact of the Medicare enrollment freeze on healthcare providers and patients.
ideas.angle: Data analysis and public records to assess the effects of the freeze on healthcare access and quality.
questions: How will the freeze affect healthcare providers?
What are the implications for patients?
What are the potential long-term consequences?
ideas.insight: This story would analyze the impact of the Medicare enrollment freeze on healthcare providers and patients, assessing the effects on healthcare access and quality.
